senses.gloss: सौमदत्ति saumadatt-i, m. pat. fr. Somadatta.
सौमन saumana, m. [su-mana(s)] blossom: 🞄ā, f. id..
सौमन्त saumant-a, a. taught by Sumantu.
सौमन्त्रिण saumantriṇ-a, n. [sumantrin] 🞄possession of a good minister (conj.).
सौमिक saum-ika, a. (ī) belonging to Soma 🞄or the Soma sacrifice.

सौमित्र saumitra, m. met. [fr. sumitrā] of 🞄Laksmaṇa;
 n. [sumitra] friendship: i, m. 🞄met. of Lakṣmaṇa: du. Lakṣmaṇa and Śatrughna.

सौमिल saum-ila, m. N. of a poet;
 -illa, m. id..

सौमी saum-ī́, V. a. f. of saumyá;
 f. moonlight 🞄(E.).
